Description:

Page 2 of 5

Nature of Complaint: Gross Negligence,
Extreme Departure from the Standard of
Care, Unprofessional Conduct (Solicitation of
Illegal Acts), and Failure to Establish/Provide
Care under Dangerous Circumstances.

Detailed Description:

| attended a scheduled intake evaluation with
Dr. Paula Bailey-Walton, a board-certified
Addiction Medicine specialist. | was
specifically referred to this evaluation by a
New Directions counselor who assured me
Dr. Bailey-Walton was equipped to medically
manage a taper off of Xanax (a short-acting
benzodiazepine).

During the clinical intake, rather than
establishing a safe treatment plan, Dr. Bailey-
Walton exhibited a severe and dangerous
departure from the standard of care:

Solicitation of Illegal Black-Market Activity:
Instead of initiating a standard medical taper
(such as a transition to a longer-acting
benzodiazepine), Dr. Bailey-Walton explicitly
asked if | could "find any longer-acting
benzos off of the street" where | was getting
the Xanax. When | stated no, she provided no
medical oversight, effectively instructing a
prospective patient to use the illicit drug
market to self-manage a highly dangerous
withdrawal syndrome.

Inappropriate Prescribing Practices: When
asked how she treats dependency, she
stated she only uses Naltrexone for alcohol
and Suboxone for opioids. Despite knowing |
was already established on Suboxone, and
despite Suboxone having absolutely no
pharmacological efficacy for benzodiazepine
withdrawal, she ended the encounter by
asking if | was "ok on the Suboxone" and
“did | need any help with that," attempting to
push an unsolicited controlled substance
rather than treating the acute condition |
presented for.

Inappropriate Delegation / Refusal to Treat:
Despite operating as a specialist and
conducting a formal intake for a patient
actively seeking help, Dr. Bailey-Walton
refused to provide direct medical
management. Even after | informed her that |
had already attempted to utilize county
resources, she initiated a call to the Los
Angeles County substance abuse helpline
